fund_name.value: Meridian Ridge Global Opportunities Fund, L.P.
fund_name.quote: Meridian Ridge Global Opportunities Fund, L.P. (the "Partnership" or the "Fund") is a limited partnership organized under the Delaware Revised Uniform Limited Partnership Act on September 8, 2024.

fund_domicile.quote: is a limited partnership organized under the Delaware Revised Uniform Limited Partnership Act on September 8, 2024

fund_structure.value: Open-end Delaware LP operating in a master-feeder structure; substantially all assets are invested in a Cayman Islands master fund, alongside a Cayman offshore feeder for offshore and tax-exempt investors
fund_structure.quote: The Partnership operates as a "master-feeder" structure. Substantially all of the assets of the Partnership are invested in Meridian Ridge Global Opportunities Master Fund, Ltd., a Cayman Islands exempted company (the "Master Fund").

management_fee.value: Class A: 1.75% per annum. Class B: 1.25% per annum. Charged on the net asset value of each Limited Partner's capital account, determined before accrual of the Performance Allocation and before giving effect to redemptions; accrued monthly, payable quarterly in arrears. Waivable at the Investment Manager's discretion.
management_fee.quote: With respect to Class A Interests, the Management Fee is charged at an annual rate of 1.75% of the net asset value of each Limited Partner's capital account

performance_fee.value: 20% of Net Profits, allocated to the General Partner at the end of each Performance Period (calendar year, or on redemption). Identical for Class A and Class B. Calculated after deduction of the Management Fee and all allocable Partnership expenses.
performance_fee.quote: the General Partner is entitled to receive a performance-based allocation (the "Performance Allocation") from each Limited Partner's capital account equal to 20% of the Net Profits allocated to such capital account for such Performance Period

hurdle_rate.value: NOT_APPLICABLE - the document expressly states the Performance Allocation is not subject to any hurdle, preferred return or benchmark. Net Profits are measured on an absolute basis.
hurdle_rate.quote: The Performance Allocation is not subject to a preferred return, hurdle rate or benchmark.

high_water_mark.value: Yes - a perpetual, per-investor high water mark implemented as a Loss Carryforward Account. Net Losses are debited and must be fully recovered before any further Performance Allocation. Reduced proportionately on partial redemption. Does not reset on a fee change, affiliate transfer or passage of time.
high_water_mark.quote: The Partnership maintains a loss carryforward account (a "Loss Carryforward Account") with respect to each Limited Partner's capital account, which operates as a perpetual high water mark on a per-investor basis.

minimum_initial_investment.value: $2,000,000 minimum initial subscription ($250,000 minimum additional subscription). Waivable by the General Partner subject to investor eligibility requirements.
minimum_initial_investment.quote: The minimum initial subscription for Interests is $2,000,000. The minimum additional subscription for an existing Limited Partner is $250,000.

lockup_period.value: Class A: 12 months from each subscription. Class B: 24 months from each subscription. Both applied per-subscription on a first-in, first-out basis. Early redemption is possible with General Partner consent subject to a 3% early redemption fee payable to the Partnership.
lockup_period.quote: Class A Interests are subject to a twelve (12) month lock-up period commencing on the date of each subscription.

redemption_frequency.value: Quarterly - as of the last business day of each calendar quarter, following expiry of the applicable lock-up
redemption_frequency.quote: Following expiration of the applicable lock-up period, Interests may be redeemed as of the last business day of each calendar quarter (each, a "Redemption Date").

redemption_notice_days.value: 90 calendar days prior to the applicable Redemption Date. Notices are irrevocable once delivered except with General Partner consent.
redemption_notice_days.quote: A Limited Partner wishing to redeem must deliver written notice to the Administrator not less than ninety (90) calendar days prior to the applicable Redemption Date.

gate_provision.value: Fund-level gate of 20% of the Partnership's net asset value per Redemption Date. Excess requests are cut back pro rata and the unsatisfied portion carries forward with priority to the next Redemption Date, subject to the gate then in effect. Applied after any suspension.
gate_provision.quote: The General Partner may, in its sole discretion, limit aggregate redemptions effective as of any single Redemption Date to 20% of the Partnership's net asset value as of such Redemption Date (the "Gate").

key_man_provision.value: Yes - triggered solely by Dr. Elena Vasquez-Hartmann ceasing to devote substantially all business time to the Investment Manager and the Partnership. Notice to LPs within 5 business days; each LP may then redeem as of the quarter-end following the quarter of notice, free of any unexpired lock-up, the early redemption fee and the Gate, on 30 days' notice. Departure of any other person does not trigger it.
key_man_provision.quote: If Dr. Elena Vasquez-Hartmann ceases for any reason to devote substantially all of her business time to the affairs of the Investment Manager and the Partnership (a "Key Man Event"), the General Partner shall provide written notice to all Limited Partners within five (5) business days.

gp_commitment.value: The greater of $25,000,000 or 2% of aggregate Master Fund net asset value, held by the General Partner together with principals, employees, affiliates and family vehicles, maintained for so long as the Partnership operates. Reducible only with majority-in-interest LP consent excluding GP-affiliated interests. GP capital bears no Management Fee or Performance Allocation.
gp_commitment.quote: has committed to maintain an aggregate investment in the Partnership, the Offshore Fund and the Master Fund of not less than the greater of $25,000,000 or 2% of the aggregate net asset value of the Master Fund, for so long as the Partnership remains in operation

fund_term.value: Perpetual - open-end vehicle with no fixed termination date, no investment period and no harvest period. Dissolves only on GP determination, GP withdrawal/dissolution/bankruptcy without a successor, or judicial decree.
fund_term.quote: The Partnership has a perpetual term and shall continue until dissolved in accordance with the Limited Partnership Agreement.

auditor.value: Thornbury & Associates LLP - independent registered public accounting firm to the Partnership, Offshore Fund and Master Fund. Fiscal year ends December 31; audited statements furnished within 120 days of year end.
auditor.quote: Thornbury & Associates LLP has been appointed as the independent registered public accounting firm to the Partnership, the Offshore Fund and the Master Fund (the "Auditor").

administrator.value: Calderon Fund Services (Cayman) Ltd. - administrator to the Partnership, Offshore Fund and Master Fund; fees subject to an annual minimum of $180,000 per fund entity.
administrator.quote: Calderon Fund Services (Cayman) Ltd. serves as administrator to the Partnership, the Offshore Fund and the Master Fund (the "Administrator").

prime_broker.value: Harrington Sloan Securities LLC and Beaumont Clarke International Ltd. Replaceable at the Investment Manager's discretion without notice to LPs. Assets may be rehypothecated, leaving the Master Fund an unsecured creditor as to rehypothecated assets.
prime_broker.quote: The Master Fund has entered into prime brokerage arrangements with Harrington Sloan Securities LLC and Beaumont Clarke International Ltd.

legal_counsel.value: Whitlock Barr & Nunes LLP as U.S. counsel; Kentish Drummond (Cayman) as Cayman Islands counsel. Counsel represents the Partnership, General Partner and Investment Manager, and expressly does not represent the Limited Partners.
legal_counsel.quote: Whitlock Barr & Nunes LLP serves as U.S. counsel to the Partnership, the General Partner and the Investment Manager.

mfn_election.value: No - the Partnership expressly does not offer a most favored nation election. Side letters may be entered into without notice to or consent of other LPs, and their terms are not disclosed or extended to other LPs regardless of investment size.
mfn_election.quote: The Partnership does not offer a "most favored nation" election to Limited Partners.
